tools.name: transfer_options
tools.description: Which of the traveler's bank points can become miles/points in a target loyalty program, at what ratio, and how many they would end up with. Based on a researched transfer-partner table (has an as_of date; ratios change and transfer bonuses are not included). Pass the traveler's balances.

tools.name: award_chart
tools.description: Typical saver award prices (one-way) by program, market and cabin from a researched table, plus known sweet spots. Use when live award search is unavailable, to shortlist programs, or to judge whether a live price is good. Prices are estimates with an as_of date; dynamic programs vary.

tools.name: points_value
tools.description: Exact cents-per-point for an award vs the cash fare, in the trip currency: (cash − award fees − what paying cash would earn) ÷ points × 100. When the award is paid by transferring bank points, pass bank + program: it applies the traveler's transfer ratio (e.g. Belgian Amex to Flying Blue is 2:1) and
